description.value: The General Public is a Japanese fusion sushi restaurant situated at Main and 17th in Vancouver, self-described as 'Sushi To Die For.' The tagline 'From Kits to Main' signals a relocation from Kitsilano to its current spot on a well-travelled urban cycling corridor. It offers both dine-in reservations and a dedicated takeout hotline.
